trust_decision.summary: HTTPConnection._tunnel decides whether caller-supplied tunnel host and tunnel header names/values (from set_tunnel) are safe to write into the raw CONNECT request to the proxy; at the pinned commit this check is ALREADY present.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'proxy tunnel headers'; HTTPConnection._tunnel is the only code that builds the CONNECT request from _tunnel_headers set by set_tunnel().

fix_sites.entry_point: http.client.HTTPConnection.set_tunnel(host) then connect()/request(); also urllib.request.urlopen via ProxyHandler for https (Lib/urllib/request.py:1315)
http.client.HTTPConnection.set_tunnel(host, headers=...) then connect(); urllib.request passes Proxy-Authorization into tunnel headers (Lib/urllib/request.py:1307-1315)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No uncovered route found: the only sink (CONNECT request bytes) is built in one function that already validates host and every header; urllib.request reaches it through set_tunnel, so it is covered by the same check.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Header values with obs-fold continuation (CRLF followed by space/tab) are deliberately accepted by _is_illegal_header_value, and the auto-generated Host header plus IPv6/IDNA tunnel hosts must keep working; an over-broad 'reject any \r or \n' or ASCII-only host check would break these.

O6_input_shapes: CR, LF or CRLF inside a header name
CR, LF or CRLF inside or at end of a header value

O8b_injection_room.sibling: set_tunnel could gain a separately-formatted auto Host/Proxy header path appended after validation in _tunnel
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: set_tunnel already synthesizes a Host header from the tunnel host; a maintainer adding a default proxy header there might bypass the per-header check if it were emitted outside the loop.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: urllib could write additional tunnel headers (e.g. a proxy User-Agent) directly instead of via set_tunnel headers
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This is where urllib splits proxy-only headers off for the tunnel; a second header-copying route here is plausible but would be a planted WHERE-type sibling only.

O9_family: CRLF / HTTP header injection (CWE-93) in HTTP client proxy CONNECT request

O10_build.toolchain: CPython ./configure && make (C compiler); Lib/http/client.py is pure Python

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Validate only header values in _tunnel (or only in set_tunnel at store time), forgetting header names and the tunnel host.

out_of_scope_notes: Pinned commit 52ee56a88e already contains the 3.13 backport 9e071c9b of this fix (Lib/http/client.py:975-990) and its tests (Lib/test/test_httplib.py:373, Lib/test/test_httplib.py:402); the task would need re-pinning to the parent of 9e071c9b.
